description: This file defines the ContextUtils class providing static methods for converting between notification and gateway context objects within an application gateway framework. It includes conversion functions between Exchange::IAppNotifications::AppNotificationContext and Exchange::GatewayContext, as well as a utility method to check if an origin string matches a specific call sign.

classes.name: ContextUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting and handling application gateway context objects.

methods.name: Exchange::GatewayContext ConvertNotificationToAppGatewayContext(const Exchange::IAppNotifications::AppNotificationContext & notificationsContext)
methods.description: Converts an AppNotificationContext object into a GatewayContext object.

methods.name: Exchange::IAppNotifications::AppNotificationContext ConvertAppGatewayToNotificationContext(const Exchange::GatewayContext & appGatewayContext,const string & origin)
methods.description: Converts a GatewayContext object into an AppNotificationContext, adding an origin string.

methods.name: bool IsOriginGateway(const string & origin)
methods.description: Checks if the given origin string matches the predefined APP_GATEWAY_CALLSIGN.
